<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="YVFvGTu7c_aof8bjWyQI"> <mxGraphModel dx="6663" dy="3542" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TB

 %% =========================================================
 %% SYSTEM CONTEXT
 %% =========================================================

 subgraph EXT[\"External Actors & Systems\"]
 Student[\"Learner / Student\"]
 Admin[\"Content / Platform Admin\"]
 MEP[\"MEP / DGEC\nOfficial Sources & Procedures\"]
 end


 %% =========================================================
 %% EDGE / DELIVERY
 %% =========================================================

 subgraph EDGE[\"Edge & Delivery Layer\"]
 CDN[\"Global CDN / Edge\"]
 WAF[\"WAF / DDoS Protection\nRate Limiting\"]
 Static[\"Static Application Assets\nHTML / JS / CSS / SVG / JSON\"]
 end


 %% =========================================================
 %% CLIENT
 %% =========================================================

 subgraph CLIENT[\"Client Application\"]
 SPA[\"React + TypeScript SPA\"]

 subgraph UX[\"Experience Domains\"]
 Practice[\"Practice\nPráctica\"]
 Learn[\"Learn\nAprender\"]
 Info[\"Official Information\nInformación\"]
 Insights[\"Diagnostics & Analytics\nDiagnóstico\"]
 Guidance[\"Guidance & Trajectory\nOrientación\"]
 end

 subgraph LOCAL[\"Local Runtime & Persistence\"]
 State[\"Application State\"]
 IndexedDB[\"IndexedDB / Local Storage\"]
 SW[\"Service Worker / Cache API\"]
 end

 Math[\"KaTeX Math Engine\"]
 Visual[\"Parametric SVG\nVisualization Engine\"]
 end


 %% =========================================================
 %% API / DOMAIN
 %% =========================================================

 subgraph API[\"Application & Domain Services\"]
 Gateway[\"API Gateway / Reverse Proxy\"]

 Auth[\"Authentication & Authorization\"]
 Test[\"Test Compilation Engine\"]
 Scoring[\"Scoring & Analytics\"]
 Knowledge[\"Knowledge / Concept Service\"]
 Remediation[\"Remediation / Nivelación Engine\"]
 GuidanceEngine[\"Guidance & Equiparación Engine\"]
 ContentRegistry[\"Content Registry\"]
 Telemetry[\"Telemetry / Funnel Analytics\"]
 end


 %% =========================================================
 %% CONTENT PLATFORM
 %% =========================================================

 subgraph CONTENT[\"Content & Curriculum Platform\"]
 Official[\"Official Reference Stream\"]
 QuestionBank[\"Proprietary Question Bank\"]
 Concepts[\"Concept Registry\"]
 Blueprints[\"Convocatoria Blueprints\"]
 VisualSpecs[\"Visual Specifications\"]
 Taxonomy[\"Curriculum Taxonomy\"]

 Pipeline[\"Content Ingestion & QA Pipeline\"]
 end


 %% =========================================================
 %% DATA / INFRASTRUCTURE
 %% =========================================================

 subgraph DATA[\"Data & Infrastructure\"]
 Redis[\"Redis Cache\"]
 DB[\"PostgreSQL\nPrimary Data Store\"]
 Object[\"Object Storage\nOfficial PDFs / Documents\"]
 Logs[\"Audit / Operational Logs\"]
 end


 %% =========================================================
 %% OFFICIAL SOURCE BOUNDARY
 %% =========================================================

 MEP -->|\"Official PDFs,\nspecifications, calendars\"| Pipeline
 MEP -.->|\"Registration / recognition\nperformed externally\"| Student

 %% =========================================================
 %% EDGE FLOW
 %% =========================================================

 Student -->|\"HTTPS / TLS\"| CDN
 Admin -->|\"HTTPS / TLS\"| CDN

 CDN --> WAF
 WAF --> Static
 WAF --> SPA


 %% =========================================================
 %% CLIENT EXPERIENCE
 %% =========================================================

 SPA --> Practice
 SPA --> Learn
 SPA --> Info
 SPA --> Insights
 SPA --> Guidance

 SPA --> State
 State --> IndexedDB
 State --> SW

 Practice --> Math
 Practice --> Visual
 Learn --> Math
 Learn --> Visual


 %% =========================================================
 %% CLIENT -> BACKEND
 %% =========================================================

 SPA -->|\"Authenticated API requests\nwhen required\"| Gateway

 Gateway --> Auth
 Gateway --> Test
 Gateway --> Scoring
 Gateway --> Knowledge
 Gateway --> Remediation
 Gateway --> GuidanceEngine
 Gateway --> ContentRegistry
 Gateway --> Telemetry


 %% =========================================================
 %% DOMAIN INTERACTIONS
 %% =========================================================

 Test --> Blueprints
 Test --> QuestionBank
 Test --> Taxonomy

 Knowledge --> Concepts
 Knowledge --> Taxonomy

 Scoring -->|\"Attempt results\"| Remediation
 Scoring -->|\"Performance events\"| Telemetry

 Remediation --> Concepts
 Remediation --> QuestionBank

 Guidance --> GuidanceEngine
 GuidanceEngine --> Taxonomy


 %% =========================================================
 %% CONTENT REGISTRY
 %% =========================================================

 ContentRegistry --> Official
 ContentRegistry --> QuestionBank
 ContentRegistry --> Concepts
 ContentRegistry --> Blueprints
 ContentRegistry --> VisualSpecs


 %% =========================================================
 %% CONTENT PIPELINE
 %% =========================================================

 Pipeline --> Official
 Pipeline --> Taxonomy
 Pipeline --> Blueprints
 Pipeline --> QuestionBank
 Pipeline --> VisualSpecs
 Pipeline --> Concepts


 %% =========================================================
 %% DATA PERSISTENCE
 %% =========================================================

 Auth --> DB
 Scoring --> DB
 GuidanceEngine --> DB
 Telemetry --> DB

 Test --> Redis
 Auth --> Redis
 ContentRegistry --> Redis

 Pipeline --> Object
 Pipeline --> DB

 Gateway --> Logs
 Auth --> Logs
 Scoring --> Logs",
